name: Weather Agent
description: Provides current weather conditions and short weather forecasts. Supports current position or a specified city and includes temperature, wind, visibility, rain information, and available weather alerts.

skills.name: Get Current Weather Conditions
skills.description: Provides current weather for current position or a specified city, including temperature, feels-like temperature, conditions, wind speed, visibility, and available weather alerts.
examples: what is the weather in Warsaw?
tell me what the weather in London
what is the temperature in Berlin

skills.name: Get Short Weather Forecast
skills.description: Provides a weather forecast for today, tomorrow, or the following days, up to three forecast days, for current position or a specified city.
examples: what will the weather be tomorrow in Warsaw?
will it rain tomorrow in London?
give me a three day weather forecast for Berlin
what is the weather going to be like in 2 days?
